title: CopperUpdate
description: Iron can now be obtained from copper.
body:
![Craft:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b59faa74acb3bd3e0dc2f24a67df9ce2474d07f9.png)

Copper is now useful. With this datapack, you can craft iron ingots from copper. And since copper is common, you can easily get iron.
